note: Extraction output for samples/calder-global-equity.txt. Triggers conditional requirements Meridian does not: an ESG data vendor and a tracking error measurement basis.

clause.text: Exposure to any single GICS sector shall not exceed the weight of that sector in the Benchmark by more than seven hundred fifty (750) basis points.
Not more than fifteen percent (15%) of the market value of the Account may be invested in issuers domiciled in countries classified as emerging markets by the Benchmark provider.

The Account shall exclude issuers deriving more than five percent (5%) of revenue from thermal coal extraction, and issuers deriving any revenue from the manufacture of controversial weapons. Screening shall be applied at the issuer level.

ambiguities: No ESG data vendor named; revenue classification differs materially between providers

clause.text: The Manager shall manage the Account with a view to maintaining tracking error against the Benchmark of no more than four hundred (400) basis points.

ambiguities: Measurement basis unstated (ex ante vs ex post)
'with a view to' may indicate a target rather than a hard limit

clause.text: The Account shall hold not less than one percent (1%) and not more than five percent (5%) of market value in cash and cash equivalents, tested at month end.
The Manager shall not hedge currency exposure except as otherwise agreed in writing between the parties.

ambiguities: Open-ended carve-back; any side letter modifying this is not visible in the document

clause.text: Forty (40) basis points per annum on average daily market value, billed quarterly in arrears, subject to an annual minimum fee of $150,000.

clauses.summary: 40bps on ADMV, quarterly in arrears, $150k annual minimum. Billing to configure the minimum-fee true-up.

clause.text: The Manager shall provide a quarterly report including holdings, performance against the Benchmark, and a summary of screening exceptions identified during the period.

clauses.summary: Quarterly holdings, benchmark-relative performance, and a screening exceptions summary. The exceptions section is non-standard and needs a report build.
